question: Construct defensible country counts
records_required: Episode-level home port, corporate domicile, flag, local labor and sales evidence; explicit historical-to-modern mapping
why_it_matters: Inventory rows include states, territories, successors and unresolved leads; counting rows would be false
release_note: All 33 archive entities are now accounted for in the coverage register; 19 map to 18 bounded public entries because Portugal and the Azores share an entry. Attribution and exhaustive regional searches remain open. No country count is published.

question: Build comparable peak-year economic panels
records_required: Annual landed or ex-factory output series, common valuation stage, exchange-rate sources, coverage of principal producing countries
why_it_matters: No valid global industry value can be obtained by adding current heterogeneous observations
release_note: A common valuation boundary, period, currency/price basis and coverage are still missing. The site publishes separate observations, no world total or economic ranking.

why_it_matters: Announcement, final catch and permanent legal prohibition are different events

question: Test worker transition outcomes

why_it_matters: Growing local fish-plant employment does not prove former whalers recovered their earnings
release_note: No worker cohort, earnings follow-up or household evidence was obtained. Local fish-processing employment cannot establish income replacement for former whalers.

question: Reconcile estimated landings and product volumes
records_required: Original Annex 6 and company stock-flow accounts
why_it_matters: Report labels raw material using seven tonnes per whale; rounding is not measured product weight
release_note: Printed p.8 and Annexes 1 and 4 were visually rechecked. The report gives 5,242 tonnes and 749 animals; 749 × 7 = 5,243. This is a one-tonne internal discrepancy, not authority to replace the source value. Product weights remain distinct from estimated raw material.

question: Resolve meal-sales amount and geographic denominator
records_required: High-resolution original pp.8 and annex table; accounting context
why_it_matters: OCR and scan interpretation differ; possible amount/scope ambiguity; omitted from baseline
release_note: The inspected scan reads Cr$11.4 million. Whether this describes all meal sales or the 79% regional share remains unresolved. No accepted meal-sales observation is added.

question: Reconcile monthly employment with stated seasonal averages

why_it_matters: Monthly counts peak at 422; narrative average depends on seasonal definition
release_note: Monthly employment and stated seasonal averages remain separate. No unique-worker or full-time-equivalent total is inferred.

The old English translation, bycatch deductions and full regulatory history remain unreconciled; actual 2026 catches are separate.
